authority.citation: Green, Karvounarakis, and Tannen, Provenance Semirings, PODS 2007

variable_rule: x_ followed by lowercase SHA-256 of the complete UTF-8 SourceInformationRecord.source_identity

canonical_form.term_order: ascending lexicographic monomial; each monomial is ascending variable
canonical_form.coefficient: explicit positive integer; zero terms omitted
canonical_form.exponent: explicit positive integer; repeated variable factors are merged by exponent addition

recursion.support_occurrence: product of every inbound GenerationBinding origin polynomial
recursion.logical_output: sum of producer-support polynomials having the same terminal logical_output_key
